description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

This isn't a "keep the lights on" role – you'll inherit processes that are still being built, and you'll have real room to audit what's working, fix what isn't, and put your own stamp on how we operate.

You'll get broad exposure early: one week you might be untangling a HubSpot workflow, the next you're building a dashboard the CCO takes into a board meeting. It's a genuinely excellent grounding in how a B2B SaaS business scales – but it comes with real pace, longer hours than a typical first job, and a learning curve to match. If you want breadth of exposure and a steep climb early in your career, this is a great seat.

What Can You Expect?

  • Keep our GTM tech stack in good shape: Own day-to-day CRM administration – data hygiene, permissions, and workflow upkeep – and support the configuration and integration of the wider stack.

  • Stay ahead of what's new: Keep across releases and new features across our tools – joining release webinars, reading release notes, and flagging what's worth adopting.

  • Help evaluate and set up new tools: Get involved as we add to the stack, from evaluation through to implementation.

  • Improve our data quality: Spot where data is incomplete or inconsistent, fix what you can, and propose fixes for the rest.

  • Build reporting and dashboards: Turn raw data into dashboards and reports that track pipeline health, funnel conversion, and the other KPIs the GTM team relies on day to day.

  • Support incentive tracking: Help maintain and monitor commission and incentive tracking, making sure calculations are accurate.

  • Onboard new GTM joiners: Train new starters across the GTM and Customer teams on our tools and processes so they're productive quickly.

  • Own our recurring admin cadence: Take ownership of the regular tasks that keep the engine running and look to automate where ever possible.

About You

  • You have a top-class academic record: you'll have graduated with (or be on track for) a 1st class degree, or have attended one of the top universities in the country you studied in – we're looking for a strong, proven track record of academic performance as the clearest early signal of the analytical rigour this role needs.

  • You're curious about how technology fits together: you likely have a STEM background, and you enjoy working out how systems, data, and workflows connect to make a business run – even if you've never worked in RevOps before.

  • You want pace, eyes open: you're drawn to a fast-scaling business precisely because of the pace, and you understand that means longer hours and a steeper learning curve than a typical grad role. You see that as a trade worth making.

  • You're happy to get stuck in: you know not every task here is glamorous – some of it is spreadsheet clean-up, data hygiene, or repetitive admin – and you take real satisfaction in doing that work well, not just the exciting parts.

  • You want to understand how B2B SaaS businesses scale: you're looking to build a first-hand understanding of the GTM engine – pipeline, systems, data, and the commercial mechanics behind it – as a foundation for wherever your career goes next.

title: Better Proposals: Junior SEO Specialist
description: Headquarters: Brighton, UK URL: https://betterproposals.io/ Are you “the one”? We're looking for a Junior SEO Specialist to join our growth team. You’ll work directly with the Growth Manager and help with everything SEO related, from keyword research and internal linking to technical SEO, content planning and link building. This is a junior role, but not a trainee position. You should already understand the basics, know your way around the usual SEO tools and be ready to work on a real website. You will not be expected to know everything. You will be expected to learn as much as possible and figure things out. What does the job look like? The role covers most areas of SEO, including: • Researching keywords and identifying new opportunities • Reviewing existing pages and recommending improvements • Finding and implementing internal linking opportunities • Creating content briefs and proposing new pages • Monitoring rankings, traffic and organic conversions • Using Google Search Console to investigate performance and indexing • Crawling the website with Screaming Frog • Using Ahrefs for keyword, competitor, content and backlink research • Finding and qualifying link building prospects • Running outreach campaigns and following up with contacts • Tracking new links and reporting on campaign performance • Identifying common technical SEO issues • Creating and checking structured data • Improving page titles, descriptions, headings and on-page content • Helping us track GEO, AIO and AI search visibility You will not do every one of these things every day, and you will not be the only one on the team. Don’t have experience with all of these? Don’t worry. Some weeks will be more focused on content. Others might involve technical checks, outreach or improving pages that are already performing well. What we’re looking for You should already understand: • The basics of technical, on-page and off-page SEO • How to do keyword research • How to assess search intent • How internal linking works • The basics of link building and outreach • How to use Google Search Console • How to use the main reports in Ahrefs • How to crawl and inspect a website with Screaming Frog • What schema and structured data are • How to use AI tools to work faster without trusting everything they produce You do not need to be an expert in every area. We are looking for someone who understands the fundamentals, can follow a process and is willing to figure stuff out when they don’t immediately understand them. You should also be comfortable working independently. You will get direction and feedback and someone will always be there for you. But we are not interested in micro management. Nice to have It would be useful if you have experience with any of the following: • SaaS SEO • WordPress or another CMS • Basic HTML • Writing content briefs • Link building outreach • SEO reporting and analytics • GEO, AIO or optimisation for AI search tools Experience with GEO or AIO is welcome, but not required. Nobody has ten years of GEO experience. A genuine interest in learning about it is enough. Benefits • Salary dependent on experience and what you can bring to the role. We use Glassdoor as a guide for your location and pay above average. • Remote work in a global company, with a friendly and hardworking team • Opportunity to grow within the company, and earn promotions and pay rises • No work on your birthday • 3 weeks paid holiday + 1 week for every year (capped at 6 weeks) • Choose 8 national holidays that make sense to your country. • Annual bonus based on personal performance Our AI policy We don’t hate AI, but we NEVER use AI tools to produce customer facing content. Our customer support is not AI based, you always have a live person to talk to. Our articles are not AI written slop, but real opinions and expertise of real people. We want it to stay that way. Using AI tools for keyword research, data analytics and process improvements is cool. Posting what ChatGPT spits out and passing it as a blog article is a fireable offence! Next steps Assuming everything goes well, here’s how our hiring process goes: • You apply • We have an initial interview • We will have a 2nd interview • In special cases we might have a quick 3rd call to clarify a few things, but mostly not. • We offer you the job • You’re expected to accept it within 1 business day. Application deadline: Friday 28th August 2026 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/better-proposals-junior-seo-specialist
